name: ACC Admissions / Owner Support
notes:
email admissions@nycacc.org or call (212) 788-4000; fill out the questionnaire linked at nycacc.org/services/surrender and a counselor contacts you within about 3 days.

Deferred intake: if you cannot keep a pet but do not want to bring it to a shelter, ACC can look for a placement while the animal stays at home with you, and can work with partner groups to help you keep it. Call 212-788-4000 and explain your situation.
